name: Titus Mountain

source.note: Piste reference data — confirm at source. Approximate base-area position about 7 mi (11 km) south of Malone village (distance per Wikipedia via search).
Search summary (2026-09-30): base 825 ft (251 m), summit 2,025 ft (617 m), vertical 1,200 ft (Wikipedia gives 370 m; 366 m here is the difference of the stated elevations).

Search summary (2026-09-30): 52 trails and glades on three interconnected mountains (another result: 53 runs); 10 lifts = two triple chairs, six double chairs, one tubing-tow surface lift and a magic carpet (stored as other); total area 380 acres (stated as area size, stored as skiable acres).
Search summary (2026-09-30): a three-lane tubing hill.

character: A family ski area about 7 miles south of Malone in Franklin County, spread over three interconnected mountains with 52 trails and glades and about 1,200 ft of vertical. Ten lifts, mostly fixed-grip double and triple chairs, serve the slopes, and there is a three-lane tubing hill.
learning: A magic carpet serves beginners (search summary). Lessons and rentals were not researched — confirm at source.

season.notes: No resort-announced 2026-27 opening or closing date found as of 2026-09-30. OnTheSnow projects Dec 5, 2026 (a third-party projection, not an announcement). Past opening dates were not captured, so no estimated window is derived.

driveFromIthaca.basis: Estimate from typical routing (NY-13/I-81 N via Syracuse to Watertown, US-11 E via Gouverneur, Canton and Potsdam to Malone, then south to the ski area); not a routing-service result. Long two-lane stretch on US-11; winter conditions add time.

airports.basis: Estimate from typical routing (US-11 E to Rouses Point, US-2 across the Lake Champlain islands, I-89 S to Burlington); not a routing-service result. Closest airport among Piste's existing codes.
